## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: File-level chunking EXTENDS Strategy E with per-file dispatch for oversized clusters; preserves file-atomicity (RegionSplitInvariantError NOT raised).

## Implementation Notes
Modify or extend `tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_region_split.py` (find via 'ls tests/scripts | grep region') OR create new test if absent.

Test cases:
- Given a diff with one giant cluster (single directory with 10 files, 6500 lines): Strategy E produces 1 cluster; Strategy F splits to 10 per-file clusters (each file in its own dispatch). Total dispatches: 10.
- Given a giant single file (8000 lines, no other files in dir): Strategy F preserves file-atomicity — file is NOT split across reviewers. Single dispatch for that file even if oversized.
- Given a typical PR with mixed cluster sizes: Strategy F triggers ONLY on oversized clusters (>= threshold_lines config); smaller clusters remain on Strategy E.
- RegionSplitInvariantError is NOT raised in any of these cases.

Add .test-index RED marker `[test_region_split_strategy_f]`.
